concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-alipay-api-only]] — 2026-09-15 Web Advanced API-only Alipay add-on for country/currency-filtered discovery, redirect and live request/test guidance; form/item-field prose conflicts with specific no-extra-field sections and TEST curl has a continuation defect.
warnings: High-level How it works says shopper enters details and request includes item info (raw lines 33–36), whereas form and /payments sections say no extra collection or parameters (raw lines 38–40, 85–87).
The TEST curl example has no line continuation after -X POST before -d (raw lines 55–69); /v72 is an example, not a stated minimum.
Country/currency discovery values and a listed alipay response do not prove a merchant is enabled or a final payment outcome.
